newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh ports employee seized smuggling gold.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh ports employee seized smuggling gold.

text.p: A Bangladeshi ports department employee was arrested at Chittagong's port as he tried to smuggle about $450,000 worth of gold into the country, port officials said on Tuesday.

Security guards stopped Jashim Uddin of the port's Marine Department as he disembarked from the Bangladeshi container vessel QC Teal on Monday, and found 168 gold bars weighing about 18.6 kgs (40 lbs) strapped around his waist.
The ship had arrived from Singapore. Uddin was arrested and taken in for interrogation, police told reporters.
Last week, Bangladesh customs officials seized gold worth about $300,000 from two foreign passengers arriving at Dhaka airport.
